prompts.rave: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game texture atlas, wide 2:1 image ideally 2048x1024. EXACTLY 8 columns by 4 rows of equal flush square cells, no gaps, no labels, no margins. Orthographic material surfaces, crafted richly shaded retro pixel game art, broad readable material shapes at 64px, quiet moderate contrast. Abandoned underground rave bunker: graphite gunmetal and muted petrol-violet metal; tiny recessed cyan accents; soil is darker charcoal mineral dust mixed with tiny rubber and cable debris, not purple gems. Soft consistent top-left illumination. Layout, zero-based coordinates: row0 columns0..3 FOUR different quiet solid armored wall surfaces with restrained joints and bolts, absolutely NO yellow stripes. row1 columns0..3 FOUR darker crumbly diggable soil surfaces, no metal framing, no masonry, no candy shapes. row2 columns0..3 FOUR special wall accents: recessed small vent, worn riveted hatch, dim cyan status lamp, ONE tiny worn yellow-black warning patch. row3 columns0..2 ONE continuous horizontal cable duct spanning all three cells; row3 columns3..5 a SECOND continuous horizontal broad ventilation beam spanning three cells. column6 rows0..2 ONE continuous vertical industrial support spanning three cells; column7 rows0..2 a SECOND vertical inset cable conduit spanning three cells. All unused cells (row0..2 columns4..5, row3 columns6..7) fill with plain matching quiet metal, no extra motifs. Continuous strips must join cleanly across their cell boundaries. Entire atlas opaque. Structural walls brighter and rigid, soil substantially darker and fragmented but SAME coherent palette. No perspective, text, logos, characters, pickups, arrows, grid outlines, white margins, bloom, rainbow neon, or repeating caution stripes. Material board not screenshot.
